title: Software publisher
description: Adapt reviews to companies that build and sell software, as a product customers install or as a service they use online (SaaS).
context: Ask the security owner whether customers ask for an ISO/IEC 27001 certification in their purchases and whether the project falls within the certified scope. This sector proposes the iso-27001-certification pattern; decline it when the organization holds or prepares no certification.

Ask the legal owner whether the organization places on the EU market a product with digital elements, software or hardware with its remote data processing solutions (Regulation (EU) 2024/2847, Art. 3(1) and 3(2)). This sector proposes the cyber-resilience-act-product pattern; a SaaS that is not the remote data processing of such a product falls outside the CRA, and recital 12 points cloud services such as SaaS to NIS 2.

For a cloud computing or managed service provider within NIS 2, Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690 sets the technical and methodological requirements of the Art. 21(2) measures and the criteria of a significant incident: ask the security owner which national law applies and select the nis2-essential-entity pattern when it does.

sources.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690, NIS 2 measures and significant incidents for digital service providers
ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 27 Journal, July 2022, ISO/IEC 27002:2022 (93 controls that form Annex A of ISO/IEC 27001)
